_metadata.description: Persistent evidence store. Per-indicator: current_status, fired_since, evidence_log of WHAT data fired it and reversal_condition. Layer 2 reads this on each run, preserves prior fired state unless today's evidence matches the reversal_condition. Live-persistence indicators (forward_pe, rel_strength, cycle matrix) are recomputed each run regardless. See src/state.py for the API and docstrings.

evidence_log.value: Framework upgraded v3.39.7: spot-only trigger replaced by 5x5 cycle matrix (contract growth × spot drawdown). May 9 doc had this fired on DDR4 spot -5% in late April, but that single-SKU signal is now subsumed into the matrix. Current matrix verdict: R1/C2 (contract +54.6% QoQ R1 band, spot drawdown -2.07% C2 band) = Not fired.
evidence_log.reversal_condition: Matrix cell moves to Partially fired (R3 mid-band, or R2+C3) or Fired (R4-R5 or C5 column or R3+C4) per cycle_matrix.MATRIX dict

t1_spot_decline.notes: Renamed from 'DDR5 spot first MoM decline' to 'DRAM Price Evolution' in v3.39.7.3 to reflect that the matrix encompasses both spot and contract dynamics. The ID t1_spot_decline is preserved for state-file backward compatibility.

evidence_log.value: LPDDR5X lead times 26-39 weeks; HBM3E sold out through 2026. No contraction.
evidence_log.reversal_condition: Memory makers report lead times contracting in supplier commentary (Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron) or TrendForce reports lead-time shrinkage

evidence_log.value: TrendForce explicit statement: 'DDR4 price cuts failed to revive purchasing activity' — classic demand destruction signature where buyers don't exist at any price
evidence_log.source: TrendForce, April 28 2026 (cited in May 9 framework doc)
evidence_log.reversal_condition: TrendForce or peer publishes statement that DDR4/DDR5 price cuts ARE reviving purchasing activity, or that demand has returned

evidence_log.value: Supplier inventory ~2-3 weeks; buyer (OEM) inventory ~10 weeks per TrendForce Q3 2025 report. A 7+ week gap is unprecedented and is the canonical 'OEM rebuilding while supplier still tight' signature.
evidence_log.source: TrendForce Q3 2025 report (cited in May 9 framework doc)
evidence_log.reversal_condition: TrendForce print shows buyer inventory falling below 5 weeks OR supplier inventory rising above 5 weeks (gap closes to under 3 weeks)

evidence_log.value: Google TurboQuant published — 6x KV-cache compression and 8x speedup on H100. This is an algorithmic memory-bandwidth substitute that reduces HBM demand per workload.
evidence_log.source: Google Research announcement, March 24 2026 (cited in May 9 framework doc)
evidence_log.reversal_condition: Not applicable — once a published technique is in the literature, it cannot be unannounced. The efficiency gain is permanent.

evidence_log.reversal_condition: IDC, Counterpoint, or Gartner publishes upgraded PC/smartphone/server forecast vs prior; OR OEMs publicly restore production cuts

Direction flips to mildly_bearish_hbm or strongly_bearish_hbm for 2 consecutive quarters, indicating efficiency/HBM-packing has outpaced enterprise demand growth. In v3.4.0 this is informational only — no automated trigger. v3.4.1+ may attach a trigger to direction transitions after shadow-validation period.

evidence_log.value: v3.4.4 framework bootstrap. Composite over 4 sub-indicators (7A CXMT, 7B Samsung HBM4/4E, 7C Micron, 7D HBF) calibrated to estimated SK Hynix EPS impact. Today: 7B Partially fired (~10% EPS, Samsung ~28-30% Nvidia HBM4 + HBM4E qualification tied); 7A/7C/7D Not fired. Cumulative ~11.5% EPS impact → Partially fired single-front.
evidence_log.reversal_condition: Indicator-level Fired requires: 2+ subs Fired (dual-threat amplifier per Part 14), OR 1 sub Fired + 2+ subs Partially fired, OR cumulative EPS impact ≥20%. De-fire to Not fired requires all 4 subs Not fired AND cumulative EPS impact <5%.

evidence_log.value: v3.4.4 framework bootstrap. Pre-F-1 state. ADR expected June-July 2026 via new share issuance (treasury path closed Feb 9 2026). ~17.4M new shares, ~$10B central case raise. All 4 sub-indicators (8A F-1 watch, 8B roadshow demand, 8C pricing day, 8D insider sales) in Pre-event waiting state. SEC EDGAR F-1 feed wired in WATCH_GOOGLE_QUERIES; daily check active.
evidence_log.reversal_condition: Pre-event → Partially fired on F-1 filing + any of (3-5% pricing discount, normal-weak demand language, second-tier underwriter lead). Pre-event → Fired on canceled F-1 (per Raul 2026-05-22), OR >5% pricing discount, OR undersubscribed roadshow, OR insider sales >$10M in window, OR peak-coincidence (completion + late Phase 4 cycle state). Fired persists through Phase 4 — no 90-day reversion per the May 22 framework decision.
